titleByLocale.fr: Expert en analyse des processus et en renseignement des données opérationnelles 80-100% (m/f/d)

jobs.description:
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join the PADI team and help unlock operational performance by connecting data, processes, and people. Working at the heart of Operations and Process Development, you’ll collaborate across functions to solve real manufacturing and process challenges through analytics and innovation. This is your opportunity to drive smarter decisions and shape the future of data-driven manufacturing.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits in Visp can be found on https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you’ll do:

• Build trusted, analytics-ready datasets by integrating, contextualizing, and structuring operational data from systems such as PI, MES, ELN, instrument platforms, and manufacturing data sources.

• Work closely with mammalian manufacturing and process teams to understand how operational data is generated, used, and interpreted within real manufacturing and GMP workflows.

• Analyze process trends, variability, bottlenecks, and performance drivers across batches, campaigns, and workflows using statistical and analytical techniques.

• Develop operational dashboards, analytical views, and process intelligence solutions used daily by MSAT, Process Development, Manufacturing, QA, and Operations teams

• Translate complex operational and manufacturing datasets into actionable insights and improvement opportunities that support process robustness and operational performance.

• Support GMP deliverables and reporting activities while identifying opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and improve underlying data and operational workflows.

• Improve operational data quality, traceability, contextualization, and usability to enable scalable analytics and reliable decision-making.

• Collaborate closely with MSAT, Manufacturing, QA, Automation, IT, and global data teams to deliver scalable, operationally relevant, and production-ready data and analytics solutions.

What we are looking for:

• Strong passion for analyzing complex process and manufacturing data and translating it into actionable insights and scalable solutions

• Ability to think beyond reporting and leverage data to improve process understanding, operational performance, and decision-making

• Experience collaborating with manufacturing and process teams, ideally within mammalian production environments

• Strong interest in working at the intersection of process science, operational analytics, and digital transformation

• Good understanding of how data is generated, structured, and utilized within operational environments

• Ability to clearly communicate complex analyses and translate them into practical recommendations for diverse stakeholders

• Hands-on mindset with a collaborative approach to cross-functional teamwork

Technical Requirements:

• Experience with process analytics, operational analytics, and industrial data environments

• Practical skills in SQL, Python, statistical analysis, and data visualization

• Understanding of data pipelines and ETL processes

• Experience with tools such as Seeq, SIMCA, Statistica, Power BI, PI System, Azure, Git, or comparable platforms

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience in a CDMO environment or knowledge of mammalian manufacturing / bioprocess development

• Interest in process behavior, variability, GMP-related support, and continuous improvement

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: (Senior) QA Expert Compliance 80-100%
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Stein, AG, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join Lonza AG as a (Senior) QA Expert Compliance, partnering with senior stakeholders to ensure robust Quality Management Systems, GMP compliance, and training oversight across various systems and document management platforms. This highly dynamic, transformation-driven role includes change review board responsibilities and cross-functional interface management, ideal for a resilient, curious professional who thrives on shifting priorities, works independently, and drives quality excellence in a fast-growing sterile manufacturing environment. Check out Your Career in Drug Product  Services at Lonza!
This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits.
The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Lead and participate in the development, implementation, and maintenance of the Quality Management System (QMS) in accordance with cGMP, ISO, and other applicable regulatory requirements.

• Act as a subject matter expert for compliance-related topics, providing guidance and training to various departments on quality principles, regulatory expectations, and best practices.

• Manage and investigate deviations, CAPAs (Corrective and Preventive Actions), and change controls, ensuring timely resolution and effectiveness checks.

• Review and approve quality-related documentation, including but not limited to standard operating procedures (SOPs).

• Prepare and present compliance reports and metrics to management, highlighting trends, risks, and proposed mitigation strategies.

• Represent the company during regulatory inspections and customer audits, responding to inquiries and demonstrating robust compliance practices.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Manufacturing, QC, MSAT, Engineering, Supply Chain and other departments to embed quality into all stages of the product lifecycle. Stay abreast of evolving global regulations and industry trends related to quality and compliance, proactively assessing their impact on Lonza's operations

What we are looking for:

• Education & experience: MSc (minimum BSc, PhD preferred) in a scientific field with extensive experience in a QA function within the GMP controlled, pharmaceutical manufacturing environment is a must

• Quality expertise: Strong QMS background with proven experience in deviations, CAPA, change control, and document management within GMP environments

• Systems know-how: Hands-on experience with document management and quality systems (e.g., TrackWise, MasterControl, DMS, Cornerstone); Experience with Veeva is highly beneficial

• Operational exposure: Experience in sterile manufacturing, pharma production, clinical testing, or similar with focus on compliance and training oversight

• Mindset & skills: Analytical, decisive, and resilient professional who communicates complex topics clearly, works independently, and thrives in fast-paced, changing environments

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: Project Scientist Phys-Chem Quality Control 80-100%
jobs.description:
The actual location of this job is in Basel Stücki, Switzerland.

For our successful Drug Product Services (DPS) focused branch located in Basel and Stein, Switzerland, we have exciting opportunities. Become part of a group that enables its customers to meet some of the greatest challenges in patient treatment and join us by applying for the Project Scientist Phys-Chem QC position.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

What you will do:

• Review and approve physico-chemical QC analytical data packages (e.g., identity, purity, content, compendial tests) under cGMP, ensuring compliance with SOPs and Good Documentation Practices

• Ensure timely tracking and closure of internal and external QC testing activities; escalate risks or delays proactively

• Coordinate sample lifecycle activities (from pull to disposal) and manage associated documentation in collaboration with QC Project Lead and laboratory teams

• Support investigations of deviations, OOX events, and CAPAs related to QC testing

• Contribute to onsite customer or regulatory audits by providing QC-related documentation and clarifications

What we are looking for:

• MSc or BSc in Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related field

• 0–4 years of experience in QC or analytical development; prior exposure to GMP environments is advantageous

• Basic understanding of physico-chemical analytical techniques (e.g., HPLC, CE/icIEF, protein content, pH, osmolality)

• Familiarity with laboratory systems such as LIMS, Empower, or Electronic Lab Notebooks is a plus

• Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to work within established procedures

• Effective communication and collaboration skills; business fluent English (written and spoken)

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. jobs.description:
Team Lead Operations (m/f/d) 80%-100%

The actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.
Join Lonza AG as a Team Lead Operations, where you will guide and empower a team to deliver high-quality projects in a dynamic and regulated environment.
This role offers an exciting opportunity to drive operational excellence while developing team performance and contributing to department success.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

• The full list of our global benefits can be found here: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits

What you will do:

• Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing operations team, fostering a collaborative and results-driven environment.

• Plan and allocate workloads to ensure timely delivery of projects while maintaining high quality standards.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, ensuring clear and effective communication.

• Support the development and implementation of operational strategies, processes, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve operational issues, escalating complex challenges where appropriate.

• Drive performance management through regular feedback, coaching, and formal reviews to support team growth.

• Contribute to recruitment, onboarding, and ensure accurate tracking of operational activities and project documentation.

What we are looking for:

• 3–5 years of leadership or supervisory experience, ideally within a scientific, manufacturing, or regulated environment.

• Strong leadership and communication skills with the ability to motivate and develop high-performing teams.

• Excellent organizational and project management skills with strong attention to detail.

• Solid analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities, with sound decision-making under pressure.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project management tools.

• Degree in Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

• Fluency in English is required; German language skills and knowledge of GxP regulations are an advantage.

Questo ruolo offre un'emozionante opportunità per guidare l'eccellenza operativa, sviluppando le prestazioni del team e contribuendo al successo del dipartimento. Cosa otterrai:
• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica.
• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico.
• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni.
• L'elenco completo dei nostri vantaggi globali è disponibile qui: https://www.lonza.com/careers/benefits Cosa farai:
• Leader, mentore e sviluppare un team di operazioni ad alto rendimento, favorendo un ambiente collaborativo e guidato dai risultati.
• Pianificare e assegnare carichi di lavoro per garantire la consegna tempestiva dei progetti mantenendo elevati standard di qualità.
• Servire come punto di contatto principale per gli stakeholder interni ed esterni, assicurando una comunicazione chiara ed efficace.
• Sostenere lo sviluppo e l'attuazione di strategie operative, processi e iniziative di miglioramento continuo.
• Identificare, risolvere i problemi e risolvere problemi operativi, intensificare le sfide complesse se del caso.
• Guidare la gestione delle prestazioni attraverso feedback regolari, coaching e recensioni formali per sostenere la crescita del team.
• Contribuire al reclutamento, all'imbarco e garantire un monitoraggio accurato delle attività operative e della documentazione del progetto. Cosa stiamo cercando:
• 3-5 anni di esperienza di leadership o di supervisione, idealmente all'interno di un ambiente scientifico, produttivo o regolamentato.
• Forte capacità di leadership e comunicazione con la capacità di motivare e sviluppare team altamente performanti.
• Eccellente capacità organizzativa e di gestione del progetto con una forte attenzione ai dettagli.
• Solida capacità di pensiero analitico e di problem solving, con il processo decisionale sonoro sotto pressione.
• Proficienza in Microsoft Office e strumenti di gestione del progetto.
• Laurea in Scienze, Ingegneria, Business Administration, o un campo relativo (o esperienza equivalente).
• È richiesta una fluidità in inglese; le competenze linguistiche tedesche e le conoscenze dei regolamenti GxP sono un vantaggio. Informazioni su Lonza A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte. L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo. Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applicare ora Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

jobs.description:
Location: the actual location of this job is in Visp, Switzerland. Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

The Contamination Prevention & Control (CPC) Environmental Monitoring (EM) team delivers critical GMP compliance outputs across the whole Visp site, including EM Batch Reports (part of the batch release process), PQ monitoring reports, periodic trend evaluations, microbiological house-flora reports and monitoring data assessments required to demonstrate and maintain a state of control. As a QA Specialist, you will strengthen data-driven quality oversight within environmental and utility monitoring, combining hands-on GMP expertise with a structured, data-informed approach to contamination oversight. You will take ownership of compliance-ready EM outputs and complex investigations, acting as SME in audits and inspections.
You will contribute to how monitoring data is collected, analysed, visualised and used to support risk-based decisions and proactive contamination prevention.

What you will get:

• An agile career and a dynamic work culture.

• An inclusive and ethical workplace.

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits can be found below.
Benefits in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you will do:

• Author GMP-compliant EM reports for EM and CU monitoring, integrating microbiological expertise, and site knowledge from investigations and facility walkdowns in support of CCS maintenance and decision-making.

• Support the review of EM outputs for batch release and certification, coordinating with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely delivery in line with batch release requirements

• Combine knowledge from cleanroom and production walkdowns with data collected from various GMP Quality systems to identify trends and assess contamination control status.

• Present and defend monitoring performance, deviations, and related actions as SME in audits and inspections.

• Ensure compliance with SOPs, GMP, and internal quality requirements.

• Lead and support complex investigations across facilities and departments, using EM data and trends and contamination control knowledge to reach well-founded conclusions

• Contribute to cross-departmental CCS status dashboards and other reporting and visualization tools.

• Identify and implement continuous improvement opportunities within reporting workflows, including lean and 6S initiatives, to reduce manual effort, eliminate waste and increase process standardisation

What we are looking for:

• University degree (PhD/Master/Bachelor) in Biology/ Biotechnology/ Microbiology/ Chemistry/ Engineering or related field.

• Strong scientific and technical background ideally with microbiology and contamination control knowledge, including familiarity with environmental and utility monitoring programs.

• Solid knowledge of GMP and regulatory requirements, including experience writing audit-ready GMP documentation (SOPs, work instructions, trend reports).

• Experience presenting and defending GMP documentation and reports to auditors and inspectors in a regulated environment

• Experience with data science tools such as R and/or Python and/or experience with Power BI or Power Automate is an advantage.

• Experience with MODA, TrackWise, LIMS, or comparable GMP systems is preferred.

• Ability to work autonomously, take ownership of deliverables, and drive tasks forward independently while managing competing priorities across routine and strategic workstreams.

• Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills in English and preferrably in German.

• Structured, proactive, and solution-oriented working style.

About Lonza
At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.
Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.
Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Posizione: la posizione attuale di questo lavoro è a Visp, Svizzera. L'assistenza di trasferimento è disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie, se necessario. Il team di Contamination Prevention & Control (CPC) Environmental Monitoring (EM) offre uscite di conformità GMP critiche in tutto il sito Visp, tra cui EM Batch Reports (parte del processo di rilascio batch), report di monitoraggio PQ, valutazioni periodiche di tendenza, report di casa-flora microbiologici e valutazioni dei dati di monitoraggio necessarie per dimostrare e mantenere uno stato di controllo. In qualità di specialista QA, rafforzerai la supervisione della qualità basata sui dati all'interno del monitoraggio ambientale e dell'utilità, combinando le competenze GMP hands-on con un approccio strutturato e informatizzato alla supervisione della contaminazione. Prenderai la proprietà dei risultati EM già conformi e delle indagini complesse, agendo come PMI negli audit e nelle ispezioni. Contribuirai a come vengono raccolti, analizzati, visualizzati e utilizzati i dati di monitoraggio per supportare le decisioni basate sui rischi e la prevenzione della contaminazione proattiva. Cosa otterrai:
• Una carriera agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica.
• Un luogo di lavoro inclusivo ed etico.
• Programmi di compensazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni. Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi lifestyle, famiglia e benefici per il tempo libero. La nostra lista completa di benefici locali su misura può essere trovata di seguito. Vantaggi in Visp: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi Cosa farai:
• Resoconti EM dell'autore GMP per il monitoraggio EM e CU, l'integrazione di competenze microbiologiche, e la conoscenza del sito da indagini e accessdown degli impianti a sostegno della manutenzione e del processo decisionale del CCS.
• Sostenere la revisione delle uscite EM per il rilascio e la certificazione di lotti, coordinando con le parti interessate pertinenti per garantire la consegna tempestiva in linea con i requisiti di rilascio batch
• Combinare le conoscenze di cleanroom e walkdown di produzione con i dati raccolti da vari sistemi di qualità GMP per identificare le tendenze e valutare lo stato di controllo della contaminazione.
• Presentare e difendere le prestazioni, le deviazioni e le azioni connesse come PMI negli audit e nelle ispezioni.
• Assicurare il rispetto dei requisiti SOP, GMP e qualità interna.
• Guidare e sostenere indagini complesse su impianti e dipartimenti, utilizzando dati e tendenze EM e conoscenze di controllo della contaminazione per raggiungere conclusioni ben fondate
• Contribuire a dashboard di stato CCS cross-departmental e altri strumenti di reporting e visualizzazione.
• Identificare e implementare continue opportunità di miglioramento all'interno dei flussi di lavoro di reporting, comprese le iniziative magre e 6S, per ridurre lo sforzo manuale, eliminare i rifiuti e aumentare la standardizzazione dei processi Cosa stiamo cercando:
• Laurea universitaria (PhD/Master/Bachelor) in Biologia/ Biotecnologia/ Microbiologia/ Chimica/ Ingegneria o campo relativo.
• Forte background scientifico e tecnico idealmente con la conoscenza del controllo della microbiologia e della contaminazione, compresa la familiarità con i programmi di monitoraggio ambientale e di utilità.
• Solida conoscenza del GMP e dei requisiti normativi, tra cui la documentazione GMP (SOP, istruzioni di lavoro, relazioni di tendenza).
• Esperienza che presenta e difende la documentazione GMP e le relazioni agli auditor e agli ispettori in un ambiente regolamentato
• Esperienza con strumenti di data science come R e/o Python e/o esperienza con Power BI o Power Automate è un vantaggio.
• L'esperienza con MODA, TrackWise, LIMS o sistemi GMP comparabili è preferita.
• Capacità di lavorare autonomamente, prendere la proprietà dei responsabili e guidare le attività in modo indipendente mentre gestiscono le priorità concorrenti attraverso i flussi di lavoro di routine e strategici.
• Forte collaborazione interfunzionale e capacità comunicative in inglese e preferibilmente in tedesco.
• Stile di lavoro strutturato, proattivo e orientato alla soluzione. Informazioni su Lonza A Lonza, la nostra gente e' la nostra piu' grande forza. Con 30+ siti in cinque continenti, i nostri team collegati a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali di collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, e questo è il tipo di lavoro di cui vogliamo che tu faccia parte. L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di tutti gli sfondi portano le loro prospettive uniche al tavolo. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti ad aiutare a trasformare le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo. Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita? Applichi subito. Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.

• Erfahrung in der Präsentation und Verteidigung von GMP-Dokumentationen und Berichten für Auditoren und Inspektoren in einem regulierten Umfeld
• Erfahrung mit Data Science Tools wie R und/oder Python und/oder Erfahrung mit Power BI oder Power Automate ist von Vorteil.
• Erfahrungen mit MODA, TrackWise, LIMS oder vergleichbaren GMP-Systemen werden bevorzugt.
• Fähigkeit, autonom zu arbeiten, Eigenverantwortung für Ergebnisse zu übernehmen und Aufgaben unabhängig voranzutreiben, während konkurrierende Prioritäten über Routine- und strategische Workstreams hinweg verwaltet werden.
• Starke funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch und vorzugsweise in Deutsch.

Lieu: l'emplacement réel de ce travail est à Viège, Suisse. Une aide à la réinstallation est offerte aux candidats admissibles et à leur famille, au besoin. L'équipe de surveillance de l'environnement (EM) de la prévention et du contrôle de la contamination (CPC) fournit des extrants critiques en matière de conformité aux BPF sur l'ensemble du site de Visp, y compris les rapports de lots EM (dans le cadre du processus de libération des lots), les rapports de surveillance de la QP, les évaluations périodiques des tendances, les rapports microbiologiques de laflore domestique et les évaluations des données de surveillance nécessaires pour démontrer et maintenir un état de contrôle. En tant que spécialiste de l'AQ, vous renforcerez la surveillance de la qualité axée sur les données au sein de la surveillance de l'environnement et de l'utilité, en combinant l'expertise pratique des BPF avec une approche structurée et fondée sur les données de la surveillance de la contamination. Vous prendrez en charge les extrants EM prêts à respecter et les enquêtes complexes, agissant en tant que PME dans les audits et les inspections. Vous contribuerez à la collecte, à l'analyse, à la visualisation et à l'utilisation des données de surveillance pour appuyer les décisions fondées sur le risque et la prévention proactive de la contamination. Ce que vous obtiendrez :
• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique.
• Un lieu de travail inclusif et éthique.
• Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent le rendement élevé. En plus d'un salaire compétitif, vous pouvez vous attendre à de nombreuses prestations de vie de famille et de loisirs. Notre liste complète des prestations locales sur mesure se trouve ci-dessous. Avantages à Viège: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi Ce que vous ferez :
• L'auteur des rapports d'EM conformes aux BPF pour la surveillance de l'EM et de l'UC, intégrant l'expertise microbiologique et les connaissances du site issues des enquêtes et des descentes d'installations à l'appui de la maintenance du CSC et de la prise de décisions.
• Appuyer l'examen des résultats de l'EM pour la libération et la certification des lots, en coordination avec les parties prenantes concernées afin d'assurer la livraison en temps voulu conformément aux exigences en matière de libération des lots
• Combiner les connaissances issues de la salle blanche et de la production avec les données recueillies dans divers systèmes de qualité des BPF pour identifier les tendances et évaluer l'état de la lutte contre la contamination.
• Présenter et défendre les performances de surveillance, les écarts et les actions connexes en tant que PME dans les audits et les inspections.
• Assurer le respect des normes SOP, des BPF et des exigences de qualité interne.
• Diriger et appuyer des enquêtes complexes entre les installations et les départements, en utilisant les données et les tendances de l'EM et les connaissances en matière de contrôle de la contamination pour parvenir à des conclusions fondées
• Contribuer aux tableaux de bord sur l'état du CCS et aux autres outils de rapport et de visualisation.
• Recenser et mettre en oeuvre des possibilités d'amélioration continue dans le cadre des processus de déclaration, y compris les initiatives de maigre et de 6S, afin de réduire l'effort manuel, d'éliminer les déchets et d'accroître la normalisation des processus Ce que nous cherchons:
• Diplôme universitaire (Ph.D./Master/Bachelor) en biologie/ biotechnologie/ microbiologie/ chimie/ingénierie ou domaine connexe.
• Une solide connaissance scientifique et technique de la microbiologie et de la lutte contre la contamination, y compris la connaissance des programmes de surveillance de l'environnement et de l'utilité.
• Connaissance approfondie des BPF et des exigences réglementaires, y compris l'expérience de rédaction de documents sur les BPF prêts à l'audit (PON, instructions de travail, rapports de tendances).
• Expérience de la présentation et de la défense de la documentation sur les BPF et des rapports aux vérificateurs et aux inspecteurs dans un environnement réglementé
• Expérience avec des outils de data science tels que R et/ou Python et/ou expérience avec Power BI ou Power Automate est un avantage.
• L'expérience avec les systèmes MODA, TrackWise, LIMS ou GMP comparables est préférée.
• Capacité à travailler de manière autonome, à prendre en charge les produits livrables et à faire avancer les tâches de manière indépendante tout en gérant des priorités concurrentes dans tous les secteurs de travail courants et stratégiques.
• Forte collaboration interfonctionnelle et compétences en communication en anglais et préférablement en allemand.
• Style de travail structuré, proactif et axé sur la solution. À propos de Lonza À Lonza, notre peuple est notre plus grande force. Avec plus de 30 sites sur cinq continents, nos équipes connectées à l'échelle mondiale travaillent tous les jours pour fabriquer les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales de collaboration, de responsabilisation, d'excellence, de passion et d'intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées de tout le monde, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et c'est le genre de travail auquel nous voulons que vous participiez. L'innovation prospère lorsque les gens de tous les horizons apportent leurs points de vue uniques à la table. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à aider nos clients à transformer des idées révolutionnaires en thérapies viables, nous nous réjouissons de vous accueillir à bord. Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie? Demande maintenant. Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

jobs.description:
Relocation assistance is available for eligible candidates and their families, if needed.

Join our Bioprocess DSP Team in Visp as Bioprocess Engineer for MMM MC1 DSP 80-100% (m/f/d) and be part of a world‑class environment where innovation meets purpose. You’ll play a key role in purifying life‑saving therapies while collaborating with talented experts in a dynamic, high-performance setting. If you’re passionate about biotechnology and want to make a real impact, this is your opportunity.

This is a fully site‑based role. Working together in person supports close, real‑time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards.

What you’ll get:

• An agile career and dynamic working culture

• An inclusive and ethical workplace

• Compensation programs that recognize high performance

• In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous lifestyle, family, and leisure benefits. Our full list of tailored local benefits in Visp can be found on https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

What you’ll do:

• Ensure that operational activities for clinical and/or commercial manufacturing are performed on-time and within given safety and quality standards

• Act as the functional lead for preparation, manufacturing execution, cleaning and changeover in the assigned area

• You will be responsible for executing and optimizing downstream purification steps—such as chromatography, virus inactivation, depth filtration, TFF, and filling—to ensure product quality, yield, and compliance with GMP standards.

• In charge of one or more defined DSP areas (e.g. gain, polishing or filling) for the purification of therapeutic proteins from mammalian (Bioprocess Engineer DSP)

What we are looking for:

• Master’s Degree or equivalent experience in Biotechnology, Biochemical Engineering, Biochemistry or related Life Science subject, or Bachelor’s holder with experience in pharma production

• Knowledge in either USP (such as bioreactors) or DSP units (such as chromatography)

• Couple of years working experience in biomanufacturing required

• GMP experience and understanding of bioprocess technology

• Excellent communication skills in English, good German skills of advantage

About Lonza:

At Lonza, our people are our greatest strength. With 30+ sites across five continents, our globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work we want you to be part of.

Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you’re ready to help turn our customers’ breakthrough ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences? Apply now.

Lonza is a global leader in pharma and biotech manufacturing. The company operates major production facilities in Visp (Valais), Basel, and Stein (Aargau), Switzerland.

jobs.title: E2E Lead 1k2k
jobs.description:
Today, Lonza is a global leader in life sciences operating across three continents. While we work in science, there is no magic formula to how we do it. Our greatest scientific solution is talented people working together, devising ideas that help businesses to help people. In exchange, we let our people own their careers. Their ideas, big and small, genuinely improve the world. And that is the kind of work we want to be part of.

This role will serve as the End to End Program Leader, responsible for planning, managing and executing the design, construction, commissioning and validation of the throughput initiative for Integrated Biologics, Mammalian Operations 1k2k Visp.
The E2E Program Leader has the full ownership of the cost, scope and schedule of the entire program, responsible for achieving the business goals of the project, including accountability for performance improvements and delivery.

Key Responsibilities:

• Establish project charter/business requirement including scope of work, goals and deliverables to support business objectives in collaboration with senior management and stakeholders.

• Ensure the conformity of the project on the goals (market, strategy, profitability) and provides its justification from a market, strategy and economics point of view.

• Provide the CAR together with key functions and present it to the approval bodies (BULT, GOLT, EC, BoD).

• Ensure the business case and CAR can be delivered from a cross-functional perspective (including capex, operations, process, procurement, QA, HR, etc).

• Establishing the project team/ structure necessary to reach the project goals and ensures appropriate coaching/development/performance feedback to all direct reports in order to develop a strong and competent team.

• Responsible for the delivery of project goals in terms of cost, time, functionality and according to client expectations. Develop the project plan and execution strategy and to set-up the contractual framework

• Ensure optimal flow of information within project organization and at interfaces with project leader/project steering committee, and mediating in case of problems. Ensure that the adequate project control/governance systems needed to manage the risk, change control, cost and schedule are timely in place & conduct regular engineering and project control reviews in order to ensure that the project execution is on track or escalated to the steering committee as necessary

• Manage scope changes and impacts in alignment key stakeholders

• Empowered to reach across functional areas and across phases of execution.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Requirements:

• Education: Master’s degree in  Science, Engineering, Business or equivalent

• Experience: 10+ years in Manufacturing / Operations

• Leadership Skills: interpersonal communication, negotiations, collaboration and management skills

• Language Skills: Proficient in English (required); German proficiency is a plus

• Ability to effectively deal with ambiguity, translate long term objectives into short term tactical plans and balance risk for overall plant and business success

• Ability to work inter-departmentally and with customers

• High level of suite specific operations and technical skills

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Ability for effective Planning, Organizing and Controlling competency

• Ability to communicate effectively at all levels in verbal and written form.  Able to manage multiple cross-functional teams simultaneously

• Ability to effectively prioritize and direct tasks in a fast-paced environment is critical

Every day, Lonza’s products and services have a positive impact on millions of people. For us, this is not only a great privilege, but also a great responsibility. How we achieve our business results is just as important as the achievements themselves. At Lonza, we respect and protect our people and our environment. Any success we achieve is no success at all if not achieved ethically.
People come to Lonza for the challenge and creativity of solving complex problems and developing new ideas in life sciences. In return, we offer the satisfaction that comes with improving lives all around the world. The satisfaction that comes with making a meaningful difference.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Oggi, Lonza è leader globale nelle scienze della vita che operano in tre continenti. Mentre lavoriamo nella scienza, non c'è formula magica per come lo facciamo. La nostra più grande soluzione scientifica è la gente di talento che lavora insieme, ideando idee che aiutano le imprese ad aiutare le persone. In cambio, lasciamo che la nostra gente possieda le loro carriere. Le loro idee, grandi e piccole, migliorano veramente il mondo. E questo è il tipo di lavoro che vogliamo fare.

Questo ruolo servirà come capo del programma End to End, responsabile della pianificazione, gestione ed esecuzione della progettazione, costruzione, messa in servizio e validazione dell'iniziativa di throughput per la Biologics Integrata, Operazioni Mammiliane 1k2k Visp.
Il Leader del Programma E2E ha la piena proprietà del costo, della portata e del calendario dell'intero programma, responsabile per il raggiungimento degli obiettivi aziendali del progetto, compresa la responsabilità per i miglioramenti delle prestazioni e la consegna.

Responsabilità chiave:

• Stabilire il progetto di noleggio / requisito di business, compreso lo scopo di lavoro, obiettivi e consegnabili per sostenere gli obiettivi aziendali in collaborazione con senior management e stakeholder.

• Assicurare la conformità del progetto sugli obiettivi (mercato, strategia, redditività) e fornisce la sua giustificazione da un punto di vista di mercato, strategia ed economia.

• Fornire la CAR insieme alle funzioni chiave e presentarla agli organismi di approvazione (BULT, GOLT, EC, BoD).

• Assicurarsi che il business case e CAR possano essere forniti da una prospettiva interfunzionale (compresi capex, operazioni, processi, appalti, QA, HR, ecc).

• Stabilire il team/struttura di progetto necessario per raggiungere gli obiettivi del progetto e garantire un adeguato feedback di coaching/sviluppo/performance a tutti i rapporti diretti al fine di sviluppare un team forte e competente.

• Responsabile per la consegna di obiettivi di progetto in termini di costi, tempi, funzionalità e secondo le aspettative dei clienti. Sviluppare il piano di progetto e la strategia di esecuzione e impostare il quadro contrattuale

• Assicurare un flusso ottimale di informazioni all'interno dell'organizzazione del progetto e nelle interfacce con il capo progetto/comitato sterzo, e mediare in caso di problemi. Assicurarsi che i sistemi adeguati di controllo del progetto/governance necessari per gestire il rischio, il controllo dei cambiamenti, i costi e i tempi siano puntuali e gestiscono regolari revisioni di ingegneria e di controllo del progetto al fine di garantire che l'esecuzione del progetto sia in pista o escalata al comitato sterzo se necessario.

• Gestione dei cambiamenti di portata e degli impatti negli stakeholder chiave di allineamento

• Potenziato per raggiungere le aree funzionali e le fasi di esecuzione.

• Eseguire altre funzioni assegnate.

Requisiti:

• Istruzione: Laurea Magistrale in Scienze, Ingegneria, Business o equivalente

• Esperienza: 10+ anni in Produzione / Operazioni

• Competenze di Leadership: comunicazione interpersonale, trattative, collaborazione e competenze di gestione

• competenze linguistiche: competenza in inglese (richiesto); competenza tedesca è un plus

• Capacità di affrontare efficacemente l'ambiguità, tradurre obiettivi a lungo termine in piani tattici a breve termine e rischio di equilibrio per il successo globale delle piante e degli affari

• Capacità di lavorare in modo interdipartimentale e con i clienti

• Alto livello di operazioni specifiche suite e competenze tecniche

• Forte capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale

• Capacità di pianificare, organizzare e controllare le competenze

• Capacità di comunicare efficacemente a tutti i livelli in forma verbale e scritta. In grado di gestire contemporaneamente più squadre interfunzionali

• La capacità di priorità e dirigere efficacemente le attività in un ambiente frenetico è fondamentale

Ogni giorno, i prodotti e i servizi di Lonza hanno un impatto positivo su milioni di persone. Per noi, questo non è solo un grande privilegio, ma anche una grande responsabilità. Come raggiungere i nostri risultati aziendali è altrettanto importante quanto i risultati stessi. A Lonza, rispettiamo e proteggiamo la nostra gente e il nostro ambiente. Qualsiasi successo ottenuto non è affatto successo se non raggiunto eticamente.
La gente viene a Lonza per la sfida e la creatività di risolvere problemi complessi e sviluppare nuove idee nelle scienze della vita. In cambio, offriamo la soddisfazione che viene con migliorare le vite in tutto il mondo. La soddisfazione che viene con fare una differenza significativa.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Heute ist Lonza ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Biowissenschaften, der auf drei Kontinenten tätig ist. Während wir in der Wissenschaft arbeiten, gibt es keine magische Formel, wie wir es tun. Unsere größte wissenschaftliche Lösung sind talentierte Menschen, die zusammenarbeiten und Ideen entwickeln, die Unternehmen helfen, Menschen zu helfen. Im Gegenzug lassen wir unsere Leute ihre Karriere besitzen. Ihre Ideen, groß und klein, verbessern die Welt wirklich. Und das ist die Art von Arbeit, an der wir teilhaben wollen.

Diese Rolle wird als End-to-End-Programmleiter fungieren und für die Planung, Verwaltung und Durchführung des Entwurfs, des Baus, der Inbetriebnahme und Validierung der Durchsatzinitiative für Integrated Biologics, Mammalian Operations 1k2k Visp verantwortlich sein.
Der E2E-Programmleiter hat die volle Verantwortung für Kosten, Umfang und Zeitplan des gesamten Programms und ist für die Erreichung der Geschäftsziele des Projekts verantwortlich, einschließlich der Rechenschaftspflicht für Leistungsverbesserungen und -lieferungen.

Wichtigste Aufgaben:

• Festlegung von Projektcharter-/Geschäftsanforderungen, einschließlich Arbeitsumfang, Zielen und Leistungen, um die Geschäftsziele in Zusammenarbeit mit dem oberen Management und den Stakeholdern zu unterstützen.

• Sicherstellung der Übereinstimmung des Projekts mit den Zielen (Markt, Strategie, Rentabilität) und deren Begründung aus Markt-, Strategie- und Wirtschaftssicht.

• Geben Sie das CAR zusammen mit Schlüsselfunktionen und präsentieren Sie es den Zulassungsstellen (BULT, GOLT, EC, BoD).

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass der Business Case und die CAR aus einer funktionsübergreifenden Perspektive geliefert werden können (einschließlich Capex, Operations, Prozess, Beschaffung, QA, HR usw.).

• Aufbau des Projektteams/der Projektstruktur, die erforderlich ist, um die Projektziele zu erreichen, und Gewährleistung eines angemessenen Coachings/Entwicklung/Leistungsfeedbacks für alle direkten Berichte, um ein starkes und kompetentes Team zu entwickeln.

• Verantwortlich für die Erfüllung der Projektziele in Bezug auf Kosten, Zeit, Funktionalität und gemäß den Erwartungen des Kunden. Entwicklung des Projektplans und der Durchführungsstrategie sowie Einrichtung des vertraglichen Rahmens

• Gewährleistung eines optimalen Informationsflusses innerhalb der Projektorganisation und an den Schnittstellen zum Projektleiter/Projektleitungsausschuss sowie Vermittlung bei Problemen. Stellen Sie sicher, dass die angemessenen Projektsteuerungs-/Governance-Systeme, die für das Risikomanagement, die Änderungskontrolle, die Kosten und den Zeitplan erforderlich sind, rechtzeitig vorhanden sind und führen Sie regelmäßige Engineering- und Projektsteuerungsüberprüfungen durch, um sicherzustellen, dass die Projektausführung auf dem richtigen Weg ist oder bei Bedarf an den Lenkungsausschuss weitergeleitet wird

• Management von Umfangsänderungen und Auswirkungen bei der Ausrichtung der wichtigsten Stakeholder

• Befähigt, über Funktionsbereiche und Phasen der Ausführung hinweg zu erreichen.

• Führen Sie andere Aufgaben wie zugewiesen aus.

Anforderungen:

• Ausbildung: Master-Abschluss in Science, Engineering, Business oder gleichwertig

• Erfahrung: 10+ Jahre in der Fertigung / Operations

• Führungsqualitäten: zwischenmenschliche Kommunikation, Verhandlungen, Zusammenarbeit und Managementfähigkeiten

• Sprachkenntnisse: Englischkenntnisse (erforderlich); Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus

• Fähigkeit, mit Mehrdeutigkeiten effektiv umzugehen, langfristige Ziele in kurzfristige taktische Pläne umzusetzen und das Risiko für den Gesamterfolg von Anlagen und Unternehmen auszugleichen

• Fähigkeit, abteilungsübergreifend und mit Kunden zu arbeiten

• Hohes Niveau an suitenspezifischen Operationen und technischen Fähigkeiten

• Starke schriftliche und verbale Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

• Fähigkeit zur effektiven Planung, Organisation und Steuerung von Kompetenzen

• Fähigkeit, auf allen Ebenen in verbaler und schriftlicher Form effektiv zu kommunizieren. Kann mehrere cross-funktionale Teams gleichzeitig verwalten

• Die Fähigkeit, Aufgaben in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung effektiv zu priorisieren und zu lenken, ist entscheidend

Die Produkte und Dienstleistungen von Lonza wirken sich täglich positiv auf Millionen von Menschen aus. Für uns ist das nicht nur ein großes Privileg, sondern auch eine große Verantwortung. Wie wir unsere Geschäftsergebnisse erzielen, ist genauso wichtig wie die Erfolge selbst. Bei Lonza respektieren und schützen wir unsere Menschen und unsere Umwelt. Jeder Erfolg, den wir erzielen, ist überhaupt kein Erfolg, wenn er nicht ethisch erreicht wird.
Menschen kommen nach Lonza, um die Herausforderung und Kreativität zu meistern, komplexe Probleme zu lösen und neue Ideen in den Biowissenschaften zu entwickeln. Im Gegenzug bieten wir die Zufriedenheit, die mit der Verbesserung des Lebens auf der ganzen Welt einhergeht. Die Zufriedenheit, die mit einem sinnvollen Unterschied einhergeht.

Lonza ist weltweit führend in der Pharma- und Biotech-Fertigung. Das Unternehmen betreibt große Produktionsstätten in Visp (Valais), Basel, und Stein (Aargau), Schweiz.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Aujourd'hui, Lonza est un leader mondial des sciences de la vie sur trois continents. Alors que nous travaillons dans la science, il n'y a pas de formule magique pour la façon dont nous le faisons. Notre plus grande solution scientifique est de travailler ensemble avec des gens talentueux, en concevant des idées qui aident les entreprises à aider les gens. En échange, nous laissons notre peuple posséder sa carrière. Leurs idées, grandes et petites, améliorent véritablement le monde. Et c'est le genre de travail dont nous voulons faire partie.

Ce rôle servira de chef de programme de bout en bout, responsable de la planification, de la gestion et de l'exécution de la conception, de la construction, de la mise en service et de la validation de l'initiative de débit pour les produits biologiques intégrés, les opérations des mammifères 1k2k Viège.
Le chef de programme E2E est entièrement responsable du coût, de la portée et du calendrier de l'ensemble du programme, qui est chargé d'atteindre les objectifs opérationnels du projet, y compris la reddition de comptes en ce qui a trait aux améliorations du rendement et à l'exécution.

Principales responsabilités :

• Établir la charte de projet/exigence opérationnelle, y compris la portée du travail, les buts et les produits livrables, pour appuyer les objectifs opérationnels en collaboration avec la haute direction et les parties prenantes.

• Assurer la conformité du projet aux objectifs (marché, stratégie, rentabilité) et fournir sa justification du point de vue du marché, de la stratégie et de l'économie.

• Fournir à la RCA des fonctions clés et les présenter aux organismes d'approbation (BULT, GOLT, EC, BoD).

• S'assurer que l'analyse de rentabilisation et le RAC peuvent être fournis dans une perspective interfonctionnelle (capex, opérations, processus, achats, QA, RH, etc.).

• La mise en place de l'équipe/de la structure du projet nécessaire pour atteindre les objectifs du projet et la mise en place d'un encadrement, d'un développement et d'un retour d'expérience appropriés à tous les rapports directs afin de développer une équipe forte et compétente.

• Responsable de l'exécution des objectifs du projet en termes de coût, de temps, de fonctionnalité et en fonction des attentes des clients. Élaborer le plan de projet et la stratégie d'exécution et mettre en place le cadre contractuel

• Assurer un flux optimal d'informations au sein de l'organisation du projet et aux interfaces avec le chef de projet/comité directeur du projet, et la médiation en cas de problèmes. Veiller à ce que les systèmes adéquats de contrôle et de gouvernance du projet nécessaires pour gérer les risques, le contrôle du changement, les coûts et le calendrier soient mis en place en temps opportun et procéder à des examens réguliers de l'ingénierie et du contrôle du projet afin de s'assurer que l'exécution du projet est sur la bonne voie ou qu'elle est étendue au comité directeur si nécessaire

• Gérer les changements de portée et les impacts dans l'alignement des principaux acteurs

• Capacité à atteindre les zones fonctionnelles et les phases d'exécution.

• Exécuter d'autres fonctions telles qu'elles sont assignées.

Exigences:

• Enseignement: Master en sciences, ingénierie, affaires ou équivalent

• Expérience: 10 ans et plus en fabrication / exploitation

• Compétences en leadership : communication interpersonnelle, négociation, collaboration et compétences en gestion

• Compétences linguistiques: maîtrise de l'anglais (obligatoire); la compétence en allemand est un plus

• Capacité de faire face efficacement à l'ambiguïté, de traduire les objectifs à long terme en plans tactiques à court terme et d'équilibrer les risques pour la réussite globale des installations et des entreprises

• Capacité de travailler entre les départements et avec les clients

• Niveau élevé d'opérations spécifiques et de compétences techniques

• Fortes compétences en communication écrite et verbale

• Capacité de planification, d'organisation et de contrôle efficaces

• Capacité de communiquer efficacement à tous les niveaux, oralement et par écrit. Capable de gérer simultanément plusieurs équipes interfonctionnelles

• La capacité de prioriser et de diriger efficacement les tâches dans un environnement rapide est essentielle

Chaque jour, les produits et services de Lonza ont un impact positif sur des millions de personnes. Pour nous, ce n'est pas seulement un grand privilège, mais aussi une grande responsabilité. La façon dont nous obtenons nos résultats commerciaux est tout aussi importante que les réalisations elles-mêmes. À Lonza, nous respectons et protégeons notre peuple et notre environnement. Tout succès que nous obtenons n'est pas du tout un succès sinon un succès éthique.
Les gens viennent à Lonza pour le défi et la créativité de résoudre des problèmes complexes et de développer de nouvelles idées dans les sciences de la vie. En retour, nous offrons la satisfaction qui vient avec l'amélioration de la vie partout dans le monde. La satisfaction qui vient avec faire une différence significative.

Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.

jobs.description:
Umzugsunterstützung: Verfügbar für berechtigte Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten sowie deren Familien.

Unser CDMO-Geschäftsbereich Drug Product Services (DPS) in Stein bietet dir die Möglichkeit, Teil eines engagierten Teams zu werden, das Kundinnen und Kunden dabei unterstützt, einige der grössten Herausforderungen in der modernen Patientenbehandlung zu meistern. Zur Unterstützung unseres DPS Growth Projects suchen wir dich als Spare Parts Manager (m/w/d) 80–100%.

Was auf Dich wartet:

• Eine agile Karriere und eine dynamische Arbeitskultur

• Ein integratives und ethisches Arbeitsumfeld

• Vergütungsprogramme, die hohe Leistung anerkennen.

Neben einem wettbewerbsfähigen Gehalt erwarten Dich zahlreiche Vorteile für Lifestyle, Familie und Freizeit. Unsere vollständige Liste der lokalen Benefits findest Du unten:

• Benefits in Stein: https://bit.ly/42DlBDk

Deine Aufgaben:

• Du baust das Spare Parts Management am Standort Stein auf, entwickelst es kontinuierlich weiter und bist zentrale Ansprechperson für alle Ersatzteilthemen in Produktion und Projekten.

• Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit mit Einkauf und Logistik und stellst effiziente, abgestimmte Prozesse im Ersatzteilmanagement sicher.

• Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Qualität, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung der Stammdaten im Bereich Ersatzteile und sorgst für eine hohe Datenintegrität.

• Gemeinsam mit Anlageningenieuren führst du Ersatzteilanalysen durch, identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und verbesserst nachhaltig Lagerbestände sowie Wiederbeschaffungszeiten.

• Du bist Key User für SAP MM und stellst die Verfügbarkeit sowie kontinuierliche Verbesserung der systemseitigen Stammdaten und Prozesse sicher.

• Du entwickelst und implementierst langfristige Strategien zur Steigerung der Anlagenverfügbarkeit (Reliability) und leistest damit einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Betriebssicherheit.

• Du erstellst und implementierst SOPs im Instandhaltungsumfeld, stellst die Einhaltung von Sicherheitsvorschriften sicher und treibst Initiativen im Bereich Maintenance Excellence aktiv voran – inklusive Schulung relevanter Stakeholder.

Das bringst du mit:

• Technisches Studium (HF, FH, BSc, MSc, Dipl. Ing.) oder vergleichbare Ausbildung mit starkem technischem Verständnis

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Instandhaltung sowie im Ersatzteilmanagement

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in SAP MM sowie Erfahrung im Umgang mit Materialstammdaten

• Analytische Stärke und Erfahrung im Definieren sowie Auswerten von KPIs

• Strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit hoher Eigenverantwortung

• Kommunikationsstärke sowie Freude an bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

Über Lonza
Bei Lonza sind unsere Mitarbeiter unsere grösste Stärke. An über 30 Standorten auf fünf Kontinenten arbeiten unsere global vernetzten Teams täglich zusammen, um die Medikamente von morgen herzustellen. Unsere Grundwerte: Zusammenarbeit, Verantwortlichkeit, Exzellenz, Leidenschaft und Integrität spiegeln wider, wer wir sind und wie wir zusammenarbeiten. Die Ideen jedes Einzelnen, ob gross oder klein, haben das Potenzial, Millionen von Leben zu verbessern, und genau daran möchten wir Sie teilhaben lassen.
Innovation gedeiht, wenn Menschen unterschiedlichster Herkunft ihre einzigartigen Perspektiven einbringen. Bei Lonza schätzen wir Vielfalt und setzen uns für ein integratives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeiter ein. Wenn Sie bereit sind, die bahnbrechenden Ideen unserer Kunden in praktikable Therapien umzusetzen, freuen wir uns, Sie an Bord begrüssen zu dürfen.

Bereit die Zukunft der Life Sciences zu gestalten?
Jetzt bewerben

descriptionByLocale.it:
Supporto di trasferimento: Disponibile per i candidati idonei e le loro famiglie.

Il nostro business unit CDMO Drug Product Services (DPS) di Stein vi offre l'opportunità di entrare a far parte di un team dedicato che aiuta i clienti ad affrontare alcune delle più grandi sfide della moderna cura dei pazienti. Per sostenere il nostro DPS Growth Project, stiamo cercando di voi come Spare Parts Manager (m/f/d) 80-100%.

Cosa ti aspetta:

• Una carriera Agile e una cultura del lavoro dinamica

• Un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo ed etico

• Programmi di Remunerazione che riconoscono alte prestazioni.

Oltre a uno stipendio competitivo, si può aspettare numerosi vantaggi per lo stile di vita, la famiglia e il tempo libero. Trova la nostra lista completa dei vantaggi locali Di seguito:

• Vantaggi in pietra: https://bit.ly/42DlBDk

I vostri compiti:

• Si costruisce la gestione delle parti di ricambio presso il sito Stein, lo si sviluppa continuamente e sono la persona di contatto centrale per tutti gli argomenti dei pezzi di ricambio in produzione e progetti.

• Coordinate la collaborazione con l'acquisto e la logistica e assicurate processi efficienti e coordinati nella gestione dei pezzi di ricambio.

• Si assume la responsabilità per la qualità, la manutenzione e l'ulteriore sviluppo dei dati master nell'area dei pezzi di ricambio e garantire un elevato livello di integrità dei dati.

• Insieme agli ingegneri degli impianti, effettuerete analisi dei pezzi di ricambio, identificare il potenziale di ottimizzazione e migliorare in modo sostenibile i tempi di inventario e sostituzione.

• Sei un utente chiave per SAP MM e garantisci la disponibilità e il miglioramento continuo dei dati e dei processi master lato sistema.

• Sviluppare e implementare strategie a lungo termine per aumentare la disponibilità degli impianti e quindi dare un importante contributo all'affidabilità operativa.

• L'utente crea e implementa le SOP nell'ambiente di manutenzione, assicura il rispetto delle normative di sicurezza e promuove attivamente iniziative nel settore dell'eccellenza della manutenzione, tra cui la formazione di stakeholder rilevanti.

Questo è ciò che portate con voi:

• Studi tecnici (HF, FH, BSc, MSc, Dipl. Ing.) o formazione comparabile con una forte comprensione tecnica

• Diversi anni di esperienza nella manutenzione e nella gestione dei pezzi di ricambio

• Conoscenza approfondita di SAP MM e esperienza nella gestione dei dati master dei materiali

• Resistenza e esperienza analitica nella definizione e valutazione dei KPI

• Metodo di lavoro strutturato e orientato alla soluzione con un elevato livello di responsabilità personale

• Forza di comunicazione e di godimento della cooperazione trasversale

• Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco e buona conoscenza dell'inglese

Informazioni su Lonza
A Lonza, i nostri dipendenti sono la nostra massima forza. In più di 30 sedi in cinque continenti, i nostri team di rete a livello globale lavorano insieme ogni giorno per produrre i farmaci di domani. I nostri valori fondamentali: collaborazione, responsabilità, eccellenza, passione e integrità riflettono chi siamo e come lavoriamo insieme. Le idee di tutti, grandi o piccole, hanno il potenziale di migliorare milioni di vite, ed è quello che vogliamo che tu condividi.
L'innovazione prospera quando le persone di diversa provenienza portano nelle loro prospettive uniche. A Lonza, apprezziamo la diversità e ci impegniamo in un ambiente inclusivo per tutti i dipendenti. Se siete pronti a tradurre le idee innovative dei nostri clienti in terapie valide, non vediamo l'ora di accogliervi a bordo.

Pronto a plasmare il futuro delle scienze della vita?
Applicare ora

Lonza è leader globale nella produzione di farmaci e biotecnologie. L'azienda gestisce importanti stabilimenti produttivi a Visp (Valais), Basilea e Stein (Aargau), Svizzera.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Relocation support: Available for eligible candidates and their families.

Our CDMO Drug Product Services (DPS) business unit in Stein offers you the opportunity to become part of a dedicated team that helps customers meet some of the biggest challenges in modern patient care. To support our DPS Growth Project, we are looking for you as Spare Parts Manager (m/f/d) 80-100%.

What is waiting for you:

• An Agile Career and Dynamic Work Culture

• An inclusive and ethical working environment

• Remuneration programs that recognize high performance.

In addition to a competitive salary, you can expect numerous benefits for lifestyle, family and leisure. Find our full list of local benefits You below:

• Benefits in stone: https://bit.ly/42DlBDk

Your tasks:

• You build up the Spare Parts Management at the Stein site, develop it continuously and are the central contact person for all spare parts topics in production and projects.

• You coordinate cooperation with purchasing and logistics and ensure efficient, coordinated processes in spare parts management.

• You take responsibility for the quality, maintenance and further development of the master data in the area of spare parts and ensure a high level of data integrity.

• Together with plant engineers, you will carry out spare parts analyses, identify optimization potential and sustainably improve inventory and replacement times.

• You are a key user for SAP MM and ensure the availability and continuous improvement of the system-side master data and processes.

• You develop and implement long-term strategies to increase plant availability and thus make an important contribution to operational reliability.

• You create and implement SOPs in the maintenance environment, ensure compliance with safety regulations and actively promote initiatives in the area of maintenance excellence – including training relevant stakeholders.

This is what you bring with you:

• Technical studies (HF, FH, BSc, MSc, Dipl. Ing.) or comparable training with a strong technical understanding

• Several years of experience in maintenance and spare parts management

• In-depth knowledge of SAP MM as well as experience in handling material master data

• Analytical strength and experience in defining and evaluating KPIs

• Structured and solution-oriented working method with a high level of personal responsibility

• Strength of communication and enjoyment of cross-sectoral cooperation

• Very good knowledge of German and good knowledge of English

About Lonza
At Lonza, our employees are our greatest strength. At more than 30 locations on five continents, our globally networked teams work together every day to produce the medicines of tomorrow. Our core values: collaboration, accountability, excellence, passion and integrity reflect who we are and how we work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s what we want you to share.
Innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds bring in their unique perspectives. At Lonza, we value diversity and are committed to an inclusive environment for all employees. If you are ready to translate our customers’ groundbreaking ideas into viable therapies, we look forward to welcoming you on board.

Ready to shape the future of life sciences?
Apply now

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Soutien à la réinstallation : Disponible pour les candidats admissibles et leurs familles.

Notre unité commerciale CDMO Drug Product Services (DPS) à Stein vous offre la possibilité de faire partie d'une équipe dédiée qui aide les clients à relever certains des plus grands défis dans les soins aux patients modernes. Pour soutenir notre projet de croissance DPS, nous vous recherchons comme Gestionnaire de pièces de rechange (m/f/d) 80-100%.

Ce qui vous attend :

• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique

• Un environnement de travail inclusif et éthique

• Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent les performances élevées.

En plus d'un salaire compétitif, vous pouvez vous attendre à de nombreux avantages pour le mode de vie, la famille et les loisirs. Retrouvez notre liste complète des prestations locales Vous ci-dessous:

• Avantages en pierre: https://bit.ly/42DlBDk

Vos tâches:

• Vous créez la gestion des pièces détachées sur le site Stein, le développez en permanence et êtes la personne de contact centrale pour tous les sujets relatifs aux pièces détachées dans la production et les projets.

• Coordonner la coopération avec l'achat et la logistique et assurer des processus efficaces et coordonnés dans la gestion des pièces détachées.

• Vous assumez la responsabilité de la qualité, de la maintenance et du développement des données de base dans le domaine des pièces de rechange et vous assurez un haut niveau d'intégrité des données.

• Avec les ingénieurs de l'usine, vous effectuerez des analyses de pièces de rechange, identifierez le potentiel d'optimisation et améliorerez durablement les temps d'inventaire et de remplacement.

• Vous êtes un utilisateur clé pour SAP MM et assurez la disponibilité et l'amélioration continue des données et des processus master côté système.

• Vous développez et mettez en œuvre des stratégies à long terme pour augmenter la disponibilité des installations et ainsi apporter une contribution importante à la fiabilité opérationnelle.

• Vous créez et implémentez des SOP dans l'environnement de maintenance, veillez au respect des règles de sécurité et encouragez activement les initiatives dans le domaine de l'excellence en maintenance – y compris la formation des parties prenantes concernées.

C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous :

• Études techniques (HF, FH, BSc, MSc, Dipl. Ing.) ou formation comparable avec une forte compréhension technique

• Plusieurs années d'expérience en maintenance et gestion des pièces de rechange

• Connaissance approfondie du système SAP MM ainsi que de l'expérience dans le traitement des données de base

• La force analytique et l'expérience dans la définition et l'évaluation des ICR

• Méthode de travail structurée et orientée vers la solution avec un haut niveau de responsabilité personnelle

• La force de la communication et la jouissance de la coopération intersectorielle

• Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand et bonne connaissance de l'anglais

À propos de Lonza
À Lonza, nos employés sont notre plus grande force. Dans plus de 30 sites sur cinq continents, nos équipes en réseau mondial travaillent tous les jours pour produire les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales : collaboration, responsabilité, excellence, passion et intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et c'est ce que nous voulons que vous partagez.
L'innovation prospère lorsque des personnes de différents horizons apportent leurs perspectives uniques. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un gestionnaire de projet Développement analytique des petites molécules (m/f/d). Dans cette position, vous dirigerez la partie analytique des projets clients pour les ingrédients actifs pharmaceutiques fabriqués chimiquement et soutenir ce travail de développement avec des techniques chromatographiques avec votre propre équipe de laboratoire.

Ce qui vous attend:

• Une carrière agile et une culture de travail dynamique

• Un environnement de travail inclusif et éthique

• Programmes de rémunération qui reconnaissent les performances élevées.

En plus d'un salaire compétitif, vous pouvez vous attendre à de nombreux avantages pour le mode de vie, la famille et les loisirs. Notre liste complète des avantages locaux se trouve ici:

• Avantages en Viège: https://bit.ly/3wjkoFi

Leurs tâches:

• Vous êtes le principal contact pour les clients dans toutes les questions analytiques pendant la mise en œuvre des projets

• À cette fin, vous planifiez les projets en fonction des attentes et des exigences des clients et les mettez en œuvre en coopération avec des partenaires dans le développement des processus, la production, l'AQ, le QC, etc.

• Vous dirigerez la mise en œuvre, le développement et la validation des méthodes et suivrez l'analyse des échantillons dans votre équipe de laboratoire (HPLC, GC)

• Vous dirigez, développez et soutenez vos collaborateurs et contribuez à l'innovation et à l'amélioration continue des workflows

Ce que nous cherchons:

• Doctorat en chimie, pharmacie ou domaine connexe ou maîtrise avec une expérience professionnelle pertinente

• Connaissances pertinentes en matière d'analyse générale et de chromatographie en détail

• L'expérience acquise dans les domaines du GMPc, du développement des médicaments, de la gestion de projets et des statistiques est bénéfique

• Ils sont fiables, flexibles, orientés vers le client et la qualité

• Vous communiquez de manière convaincante en allemand et en anglais et agissez de manière entrepreneuriale

À propos de Lonza
À Lonza, nos employés sont notre plus grande force. Dans plus de 30 sites sur cinq continents, nos équipes en réseau mondial travaillent tous les jours pour produire les médicaments de demain. Nos valeurs fondamentales : collaboration, responsabilité, excellence, passion et intégrité reflètent qui nous sommes et comment nous travaillons ensemble. Les idées, grandes ou petites, ont le potentiel d'améliorer des millions de vies, et c'est ce que nous voulons que vous partagez.
L'innovation prospère lorsque des personnes de différents horizons apportent leurs perspectives uniques. Chez Lonza, nous apprécions la diversité et nous nous engageons à créer un environnement inclusif pour tous les employés. Si vous êtes prêt à traduire nos clients en thérapies viables, nous sommes impatients de vous accueillir à bord.

Prêt à façonner l'avenir des sciences de la vie?
Appliquer maintenant

Lonza est un leader mondial dans la fabrication de produits pharmaceutiques et de biotechnologies. La société exploite d'importantes installations de production à Viège (Valais), Bâle et Stein (Argovie), Suisse.
